verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged over the native protocol and HTTP interface. Its docs also name BI tools that connect (Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau, DBeaver), so dashboards can connect without custom glue. Coverage is only partial because JDBC and ODBC are never explicitly named, and the BI integrations are inherited claims rather than tool-specific setup guides. missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, per-tool BI integration guides, independent or hands-on corroboration that dashboards connect unchanged.

support.subject: As an analyst, standard drivers (JDBC/ODBC) and documented BI-tool integrations connect my dashboards without custom glue

citations.quote: Any BI, dashboard, or SQL tool that connects to ClickHouse connects to ObsessionDB: Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau, DBeaver, and the rest.
every ClickHouse client and driver works against ObsessionDB unchanged. You change the host and credentials, nothing else.
ObsessionDB speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged.
